name: deep_dive
description: Takes analysis from parent job and generates targeted web searches

analyzers.name: query_generator
analyzers.user_prompt_template:
Analyze this intelligence summary and generate THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT targeted web search query:

{analysis_text}

Choose the ONE query that would uncover the most critical information about:
- The most significant players or events
- The highest-impact implications
- The most important context missing from the summary

Output ONLY the JSON object with your single query and justification.
